known_issues: Yellow accents are hue-remapped from amber renders; if regenerating, apply the same remap or prompt a green-free palette and check highlights
shield cut-out is semi-transparent glass, use on red or ink grounds
v2 (green) files stay in raw/ and cutout/ as *-v2
note_process: cloud-upload, scanner, pencil and pdf-export were generated 2026-11-08 for the process section; background removal ran on the base64 of the flux output
palette_change: 2026-11-08: owner asked for a real punk yellow; accent changed from #83fd80 (mint) to #f2ff00. Objects regenerated with flux-1.1-pro using "electric acid punk yellow #f2ff00 ... no green anywhere"; the model rendered amber, so the yellow regions were remapped to #f2ff00 by a hue remap (hue 32-66 deg -> ~63.5, saturation and value lifted). The CV sheet reuses the v2 render (hue remap of the green badge) because the white sheet vanished in the new background removal.
note_cv_hero: Header band remapped to #f42902 only above 30% of the object height, seal remapped to punk yellow only below 62%, so shading elsewhere is untouched. Options h1-h3 are in rejected/.
note_variety: 15 extra objects generated 2026-11-08 for per-section variety. sparkle and pin were rejected (ragged yellow after the hue remap, splashy shadow).
cutout_change: 2026-11-08 v4: every served object was re-cut with Replicate bria/remove-background (preserve_partial_alpha) from blue-gray background renders. The earlier 851-labs/background-remover cut removed white and glassy interiors (shield, target, star, plane). Yellow regions use a soft hue remap to #f2ff00. shield, magnifier, star and cv-sheet were regenerated for cleaner shapes.
